annotations.title: Check what a Fortitude21 product needs cleared

description: For one product, what Fortitude21 publishes about its certification and its cautions, the exact scope of any UN status, the documents that exist for it, and the information a quotation still needs. It reports what the publisher states and does not state what any market requires, nor that Fortitude21 holds a certificate: UN approval is granted per design type and the authority decides which plants it covers. For the regulations themselves it points at the dangerous goods tools on this same server.
